Negotiating Democracy at the OpenDemocracyLab

Our democracies and constitutions rest on foundations that were originally laid in a very different world. In this participatory workshop, IG Demokratie invites participants to explore the roots of the current crisis of democracy.

The Elon Musk Antagonist

Elon Musk wielded a chainsaw against public services, social and environmental rights. Attac flips it: Within the participative performances people can oppose the power of billionaires, tech oligarchs and the ultra-rich. Come and watch how power gets dismantled and alternatives built.

Seeds of the Unthinkable

Researchers from INVI and University of Copenhagen show you how to use AI to imagine new futures for our food and health systems, from what lives in our soils today to what will land on our plate in 2050. Decode AI-generated images, make your own visions come to life and help expand the collective imagination!
